source.title: The Troll Scroll
source.description:
<The ancient glyphs resolve into words before your eyes.>

When Zul'Kunda's fountain runs with the waters of the holy spring, the gods grant their blessing.
source.objective: Solve the riddle of the scroll. Once you've done that, Hemet Nesingwary might like to hear the tale.
source.completion:
A magic fountain hidden in the jungle? What a story, <name>!

That gives me an idea for another chapter in my book! Let's see, where did I put that manuscript...
